The unstoppable computer virus may already have a name - Morris II. Unlike traditional malware, this generative AI worm doesn’t need you to click a suspicious link, open an attachment, or download a file. An AI assistant simply has to read the wrong email, document, or image.

This video explores how researchers created Morris II, the world’s first generative AI worm, and tested it against systems powered by ChatGPT, Gemini, and other AI models. Hidden prompt injections can potentially steal sensitive information, spread themselves through email, and turn infected AI assistants into part of the attack without the user realizing anything is wrong.

title: The UNSTOPPABLE Computer Virus is HERE...
